title: Rubber Band wrapper: RAII state, null check, no u32 truncation, key-frame validation
description:
`crates/apricity-dsp/src/rubberband.rs:101-148` is one large unsafe block with no SAFETY comments. It does not null-check `rubberband_new`; it frees the state by hand at the end, so a panic inside leaks it; it truncates `frames`, key-frame positions and `channels` to `u32`; and it does not enforce the documented strictly-increasing key-frame rule (line 64). `rubberband.rs` has no tests of its own; `build.rs` uses `expect`/`unwrap` on `WASI_SDK_PATH`.

Done when: the state handle is an RAII wrapper with `Drop`; `rubberband_new` failure is an error; lengths are checked before conversion; key frames are validated with an error; tests cover a null state, an out-of-order key frame and the round-trip.
